title: Ben Temalyon
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Meilah 17a (17b for the episode in the linked edition)](https://www.sefaria.org/Meilah.17b.5-6), a miracle was performed for Israel through him in the time of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai, when the latter went to Rome to annul the decrees. [Rashi explains](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Meilah.17b.5.1) that Ben Temalyon is the name of a demon.[^1]

notes.text: The [earlier passage in Meilah 17a](https://www.sefaria.org/Meilah.17a.10-11) mentions Rome, Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai and the decrees. Ben Temalyon’s part in the story is on 17b in the linked edition. Rashi identifies him as a demon.
